paite: Judah tungtang a TOUPA thu kilakna: Van phalhkhia a, lei kingakna koih a, mihing sung a mihing kha koihpa, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
heading: Judah Ahat Ding Hi

paite: "Ngai in, kho kimvel a mite a ding in hoina nou in Jerusalem ka bawl ding a, Judah tung ah leng, Jerusalem lakna ah ahi ding hi.

Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, mi tengteng a ding in Jerusalem suang chimtakhuai in ka bawl ding a, ama ziak a tunggik kisate nakpi in liamsak in a-om ding ua, amah dou ding in leitung a nam tengteng akikhawmkhawm ding uhi.
Huai ni chiang in lamdangsakna toh sakol chih ka khen ding a, hehna toh atungtuangmi; huan Judah inkote tung ah ka mit ahak ding a mittawtna in mite sakol chih ka gawt ding hi.
Judah hausate'n alungtang un, Jerusalem a tengte'n sepaihte' TOUPA a Pathian uah hatna anei uh," achi ding uhi.

Huai ni chiang in Judah hausate sing lak a mei-am bang in ka bawl dia, buhphal lak a meisel bang in akimvel, khut taklam pang leh veilam pang a mite tengteng anegai ding uh. Jerusalem ahihleh ama mun, Jerusalem mahmah ah ahong teng nawn ding hi.
TOUPA'N amasa in Judah puaninte leng ahondam ding; David inkote thupina leh Jerusalem a tengte thupina Judah tung akiliksaklouhna ding in.
Huai ni chiang in TOUPA'N Jerusalem a tengte ahum ding a, alak ua hatloupen leng huai ni chiang in David bang ahi ding a; David inkote Pathian bang in a-om ding, ama ua pai TOUPA angel bang in.
Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, Jerusalem dou ding a hong kuan nam tengteng hihse ding in ka kuankhe ding hi.

Huan David inkote tung leh Jerusalem a tengte tung ah hehpihna leh thumna kha ka sungbo ding a; asutpa uh lam a-en ding uh; amah asuun ding ua, mi'n atapa neihsun asuun bang in, mi'n ata masa khasetak a akah bang in, amah akah ding uhi.
heading: Jerusalem Suunna

paite: Huai ni chiang in Jerusalem ah suunna thupi a-om ding, Megiddon Phaizang a Hadad-rimmon suunna bang in.
Huan gam pumpi in asuun dia; inkuan chih in atuam in, David nam inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in; Nathan nam inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in;
Levi nam inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in; Shimei inkote atuam in, azite un atuam in;
inkuan om lai teng a inkuan chih atuam in, azite un atuam in.
